summary: The design separates historical milestone proof from the current accepted baseline. It validates the original exact milestone as the first first-parent commit after its authorized baseline and requires it to remain reachable on the authorized target, while later projected-file drift continues through exact human adoption or restore without treating descendant commits as reviewed. New no-wait target facts make target identity durable. Representable missing proof enters a server-authenticated same-position fresh review cycle with authority cutoffs; content-preserving rewritten history with no committable delta returns explicit safe inspection rather than a synthetic commit. Governing PRD/task-design/phase-design bytes are classified by successor consumption at every handoff, including when co-produced by implementation, and cannot be baseline-adopted into dependent work without owning review. Baseline decisions bind the full path/digest/committedness subject, disclose uncommitted clone limits, tolerate unrelated descendants that do not change that subject, and refresh genuinely stale interfaces without fabricating a human choice. The plan is one atomic phase because contracts, Git proof, recovery transitions, gate behavior, skills, documentation, and end-to-end verification form one inseparable authority boundary. Automatic counter-review and constitution review completed with no remaining findings after revisions.
